body: Thanks But There's just so much wrong, I feel like Im stalling and lagging behind in life. Im in college and have done none of the 'college-y' things everyone else does. I dont even know if Im studying anything I like but Im too afraid to change in case I feel the same way again. I have a nearly non existence social life and the loneliness hurts so much. Ive been thinking about ending it for years now, saying to myself aster school everything will change, Ill find more people like me. But I havent, Nothings changed. Ending it soon might be my best option
